verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a hosted payment service like the CDP Facilitator, so the axis applies. The pack documents no export feature: no transaction-history download, no open-format data dump, no account-exit tooling. Vendor-neutral protocol governance ('free of lock-in'), self-custody payout addresses and onchain settlement are adjacent openness traits or properties of the host blockchain, not a product capability to export your data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
